name: How long does it take to repair damaged paint?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair damaged paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a paint repair project depends on the size and complexity of the damage. Minor repairs, such as small chips or scratches, might only take a few hours to a full day, including drying time. More extensive damage, like significant peeling or multiple areas requiring attention, could extend to several days. We provide a projected timeline during the initial assessment, considering preparation, painting, and drying stages to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time for damaged paint varies; minor issues take hours to a day, while extensive damage may require several days.
